Assoc. Prof. Ir. Ts. Dr. Norazila Othman is a Senior Lecturer in the Department of Aeronautics, Automotive and Ocean Engineering at Universiti Teknologi Malaysia (UTM). She earned her Bachelor of Engineering in Mechanical Engineering (Aeronautics) and Master of Engineering in Mechanical Engineering (Propulsion) from UTM. She subsequently advanced her academic journey in Japan, completing her Doctor of Philosophy (PhD) in Applied Aerodynamics at Tokyo Metropolitan University.

Her research expertise encompasses a diverse and highly technical range of engineering fields. She specializes in applied aerodynamics for aircraft design and performance, alongside the enhancement of aircraft and rocket propulsion engines. Furthermore, Dr. Norazila is actively engaged in sustainable energy research, specifically focusing on combustion characteristics, emissions, and the production of both liquid (biodiesel, biojet, and synthetic fuels) and gas (syngas) biofuels. To drive innovation in these areas, she extensively applies process optimization techniques utilizing Response Surface Methodology (RSM) and Artificial Neural Networks (ANN).

As a prolific academic, she has a robust publication record, frequently contributing high-impact research on topics such as thermo-acoustic instabilities, biofuel combustion optimization, and advanced gasification technologies to the global scientific community.

column4: Ir. Dr. Norikhwan Hamzah is a Senior Lecturer in the Department of Thermofluids, Faculty of Mechanical Engineering, Universiti Teknologi Malaysia (UTM). column5: Dr. Ibtisham has a background in mechanical engineering specializing in lithium-ion batteries, energy storage and management and heat transfer. This knowledge is integrated in a system level primarily in the area of transportation with the aim to analyse and for performance prediction.

column7: Assoc. Prof. Dr. Ts Mohd Fairus Mohd Yasin is a senior lecturer in Department of Thermofluid, Faculty of Engineering, School of Mechanical Engineering. column8: Assoc. Prof. Dr. Aminuddin is an active researcher focusing in combustion, flame dynamics, combustion engines and heat transfer. column11: Ts. Dr. Mohd Zamri Bin Mohd Yusop obtained his Doctor of Engineering from the Nagoya Institute of Technology, Japan, in 2013. His doctoral research examined the structural and electrical properties of ion induced carbon nanofibers using in-situ transmission electron microscopy. He completed his Bachelor of Mechanical Engineering (Applied Physics) and his Master of Engineering at the same institution, and served as a postdoctoral fellow under the New Energy and Industrial Technology Development Organization (NEDO) programme in Japan. His current research covers the synthesis of graphene and carbon nanotubes and nanofibers from biomass and agricultural waste, surface modification by ion irradiation, field electron emission devices, and biodegradable zinc based alloys for biomedical applications. He is a certified microscopist for the atomic resolution analytical microscope (JEOL ARM 200F) and serves as a Associate Research Fellow and Head of the Strategic Relations Unit at the Advanced Membrane Technology Research Centre (AMTEC), Universiti Teknologi Malaysia. He is an active reviewer and editorial board member for several international journals, and his recent recognitions include the appointment as Exco member in Microscopy Society of Malaysia and appointment as a Young Scientists Network affiliate of the Academy of Sciences Malaysia.
